_README: REAL Elementix payloads, captured verbatim from the live API on 2026-08-09.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The connector was written against GUESSED field names, and
its tests were written against the same guesses — so the tests passed while the
code could not read a single real record. A fixture invented by the same person
who wrote the reader proves only that they were consistent with themselves.
RULE: every test of a vendor reader reads from THIS file. Do not hand-write a
vendor row in a test. If a shape changes, re-capture it here from a live call
and let the tests fail until the reader is corrected — that failure is the
Trimmed to the fields the readers touch, plus the ones that previously misled.
Nothing is renamed; keys are exactly as the vendor sent them.

match_entity._note: SINGULAR `match` OBJECT — not an array, and not under any key rowsOf looked for. The name is `originalName`/`normalizedName`, never `name`.

get_entity_deeds._note: Envelope is {data, nextPage}. A ROW HAS NO `address` FIELD — it has `addresses[{id,addressFull}]`. The price is `totalConsideration` (never `consideration`) and the date is `recordingDate` (never `recordedDate`). `isGrantee`/`isGrantor` are computed SERVER-SIDE against the entity that was queried.

data._note: dataSource 'external' — the SAME transaction can appear again as 'elementix' with a different id. De-duplicate or one flip counts twice.

get_entity_mortgages._note: The amount is `mortgageAmount`, the parties are `borrowerNames` (not `borrowers`), and the term is `loanTermMonths`. `deedConsideration` is a STRING here while `totalConsideration` is a NUMBER on a deed. `loanPurpose:'refinance'` does NOT by itself mean an exit — a 10-month bridge can carry it.

data._note: Our own loan. `lenderName` 'YS Capital Group' — the short-term-loan test can read our own book directly.

_documented_not_captured._note: Recorded in docs/research/elementix/04-connector-verification.md §14 from a live call by the verification research pass, but NOT re-captured here by hand. A reader for one of these must be proven against a fresh capture before it is trusted.
get_address_ownership_row_keys: entity_grantees[] (snake_case — the only one in the API)

_paging._note: PROVEN 2026-08-09: `get_entity_deeds` was called with {limit: 2} and returned FIVE rows. The page-size parameter is `perPage`; `limit` is ignored silently, and the default page is 5. A 29-property portfolio read through `limit` reads as five and nothing anywhere says so.

_param_names._note: PROVEN 2026-08-09: get_entity_deeds({entityId}) was REJECTED — 'Invalid arguments ... path: [id] ... expected string, received undefined'. The entity/address/person tools take `id`.
